release_recommendation: Hold merge and release: latest full pass rate is 86%, below the agreed 90% target. Web integration and UI acceptance also remain outstanding.
limitations: A pass is a manual acceptance verdict on this fixed set, not a population-wide accuracy estimate.
Expected privacy/scope refusals and honest inability to verify exact phone roles count as passes only where the locked rubric permits them.
Medical and provider sources were checked selectively; no exhaustive clinical audit or live phone confirmation.
The standalone agent still requires compatible web integration and HTTP/UI acceptance.
No user-facing messages, rescue alerts or production database operations were triggered by tests.
